scope: Real durable Redis; isolated disposable verification namespace; no model inference.
checks: Six parallel reservations across two Redis clients admitted exactly two; reinitialization preserved the exhausted ledger.
Session state persisted between workers; separate sessions remained isolated; simultaneous same-session mutation was rejected.
A superseded lease could neither save its stale state nor delete the newer worker lock.
A missing ledger disabled requests; the 30-second interval and five-call session allowance rejected requests without consuming more global quota.
